features.description: Seven loop termination triggers with pause-not-stop semantics (except global circuit breaker, which is hard-stop)
steps: Implement: iteration cap, budget ceiling, wall-clock timeout, no-progress detection, diminishing-returns detection, convergence collapse, global circuit breaker
Pause-for-approval (6 of 7): write diagnostic to INBOX.md, fire notification, await RESPONSE: edit, reset counters on approval
Global circuit breaker (hard): after 3 consecutive cap-hits in 24h across plans, pause all autonomous work
Synthetic tests for each trigger condition
features.acceptance: 7 synthetic scenarios each trigger correct termination; 6 produce pause-and-resume behavior, 1 (global) produces hard stop with operator alert

features.acceptance: Mock Claude weekly at 75% → cross-cutting plan defers; mock reset → plan launches. Mock human Claude request 15 min ago → Claude-heavy plan defers 15 min

features.description: quota_check.py writes ~/.jarvis/quota_state.json (per-model weekly consumption) AND supervisor reads it before every dispatch.
